text.title: Graceful Offboard Script Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals from the QBR data, the contract and the draft script to the rule from 01-core-rules.xml that governs the next action.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the QBR source of record show at least two quantified bad-fit signals against stated targets for this client?

conclusion.verdict: do not draft an offboard; without the QBR data the decision cannot be evidenced; fetch the data or wait for the next QBR cycle.
do not offboard yet; one signal is an intervention (repricing, scope reset), not an exit; revisit at the next QBR.

branch.question: Does the intended last service date honour the termination clause, and are prepaid or committed periods accounted for?

conclusion.verdict: move the last service date to what the clause allows; state delivery or refund of any prepaid period; quote the clause id.

branch.question: Do the script, handover plan, alternative and delivery plan pass the checks?

conclusion.verdict: rewrite in the fit and alignment framing; remove every confession and every criticism of the client.
complete the per-asset inventory with owner, method and date; transfer client-owned assets on schedule.
confirm a matched alternative provider first; record the confirmation; offer the warm introduction.
schedule the live conversation with the named account owner; send the written script within one business day after it.
schedule the T+30 NPS or feedback request before the offboard is delivered.
assign the primary root-cause category and state the intake or qualification change it triggers.
deliver the offboard: live conversation, written script and handover plan within one business day, T+30 feedback scheduled, internal record filed.

text.example: QBR shows margin 11% against 30% target for three quarters and 14 out-of-scope requests against a cap of 4 → two signals. Contract allows exit on 30 days' notice; last service date set 35 days out. Script passes the banned-phrase check, asset inventory has 9 items with dates, partner agency confirmed on 2026-06-02, call booked, written follow-up drafted, T+30 request scheduled, root cause = scope and expectations, intake now asks for a scope-change budget → run-the-checklist.
